page.layout: One text column, full width, with two marginal notes on the right. Running head across the top, page number at top right. Signature and catchword at the foot. Left-edge strip belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: quòd eum incestus cum Herodiade fratris Philippi coniuge commissi coargu-isset, {g} incarcerauit, ad saltatricis rogatum mandauit eius caput amputari, & in spurcissimæ fœminæ, quæ eius san-guinem sitiebat gremium tradi, quin &(si Pharifæis credendum){h} Christum ipsum voluit interficere; neque tamen Christus multitudinem quæ illum tur-matim sequebatur, ad seditionem pro-vocat, vel aliquem è sæce plebis ad Herodem clanculum interficiendum licitat, aut conducit: sed profitetur se miracula deinceps operaturum, nec tam vereri Herodis minas, quam mandata sui patris, qui tandem Herodi & patri & filio, iustam suorum scelerum vltionem diuinitùs immisit, ut vos Satrapæ & Dynastæ, vel hinc discatis.:

p.i: Sigenus humanum & mortalia temnitis arma, At sperate Deum memorem fandi atq; nefandi.

main_text.p: Archilao in Iudæa ex Cæsaris mandato succedit Pontius Pilatus, huic etiam obediens fuit Christus ad mortem vsque, ad mortem crucis non minus igno-

page.notes: Marginal notes "g Mat.14." and "h Luc.13." are in the right margin; they are written as notes at the place of their reference marks. The reference mark "g" in the text is printed as a small glyph resembling long s; read here as "g" from the margin note, with some doubt. The "h" mark after the closing parenthesis is clear. Printed "discatis.:" is copied as it stands, including the colon after the stop. Verse lines printed as one stanza. "Sigenus" and "Atsperate" are set without spaces in the print; the space in "At sperate" is supplied as the most likely reading.
